requirements.text: * Proficiency in C and/or C++, and in Python or another scripting language
* Solid grounding in probability, statistics, and classical machine learning (detection, regression, classification), through coursework, projects, or work experience
* Degree in Electrical Engineering, Computer Engineering, Computer Science, Software Engineering, Mechatronics, or a related field, or equivalent experience with evidence of exceptional ability
* Experience with real-time or embedded systems and microcontroller toolchains (debuggers, oscilloscopes, logic analyzers) is a plus
* Experience with signal processing, detection theory, or time-series analysis is a plus
* Hands-on experience testing and debugging hardware is a plus
